description: Use this to check whether the CMF sanctioned a Chilean securities issuer in the securities market (2002 onward). Pass rut. The CMF searches its sanctions register by name, not by RUT, so results come with the name searched and a match_note: a resolution may concern a similarly named company or several companies at once; open document_url (the resolution) before attributing it. An empty list means none found under that name. Access: open to anonymous agents (rate-limited); a free AndesPass key raises the limit.

rut.description: The issuer's RUT (Chilean tax id), e.g. 61.808.000-5.
rut.title: Rut
